description_en: Adds a domain name to a WAF instance for Website Config protection
description_zh: 将域名接入WAF实例进行防护
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi create-domain --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --domain www.aliyundoc.com --listen '{"HttpsPorts":[443],"ProtectionResource":"share","CustomCiphers":["ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA384"],"TLSVersion":"tlsv1","Http2Enabled":true,"CertId":"123","CipherSuite":2,"EnableTLSv3":true,"IPv6Enabled":true,"HstsPreload":false,"FocusHttps":true,"HstsMaxAge":365000,"SM2CertId":"123-cn-hangzhou","SM2Enabled":true,"XffHeaders":["Client-ip"],"XffHeaderMode":1,"ExclusiveIp":true,"SM2AccessOnly":true,"HttpPorts":[80],"HstsIncludeSubDomain":true}' --redirect '{"BackendPorts":[{}],"SniEnabled":true,"CnameEnabled":true,"BackupBackends":["2.2.XX.XX"],"ReadTimeout":200,"Http2Origin":true,"XClientIp":true,"SniHost":"www.aliyundoc.com","WebServerType":true,"RoutingRules":"rs_:_1.1.XX.XX_,_backupRs_:_2.2.XX.XX_,_locationId_:_535,_location_:_test1111","RequestHeaders":[{}],"MaxBodySize":2,"ConnectTimeout":120,"ProxyProtocol":false,"Keepalive":true,"KeepaliveTimeout":15,"WLProxyClientIp":true,"Backends":["1.1.XX.XX"],"FocusHttpBackend":true,"WriteTimeout":200,"XTrueIp":true,"Http2OriginMaxConcurrency":128,"Retry":true,"KeepaliveRequests":1000,"XffProto":false,"Loadbalance":"roundRobin"}' --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDomain

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.
You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the certificate to add. This parameter is used only when HttpsPorts is not empty, which indicates that the domain name uses HTTPS
fields.help_zh: 要添加的证书的ID。仅HttpsPorts取值不为空（表示域名使用HTTPS协议）时，使用该参数
fields.name: cert_id

fields.help_en: The type of cipher suite to add. This parameter is used only when HttpsPorts is not empty, which indicates that the domain name uses HTTPS. Valid values:
fields.help_zh:
要添加的加密套件类型。仅HttpsPorts取值不为空（表示域名使用HTTPS协议）时，使用该参数。取值：

1：表示添加全部加密套件。

2：表示添加强加密套件。仅TLSVersion取值为tlsv1.2时，可选择该取值。

99：表示添加自定义加密套件。仅TLSVersion取值不为tlsv1.3时，可选择该取值
fields.name: cipher_suite

fields.help_en: The custom cipher suites to add
fields.help_zh: 要添加的具体自定义加密套件
fields.name: custom_ciphers

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to support TLS 1.3. Valid values:
fields.help_zh:
是否支持TLS1.3版本。取值：

true：表示支持TLS1.3版本。

false：表示不支持TLS1.3版本。

仅HttpsPorts取值不为空（表示域名使用HTTPS协议）时，使用该参数。当TLSVersion为tlsv1.3时，此值必须为true
fields.name: enable_tlsv3

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable an exclusive IP address. This parameter is used only when IPv6Enabled is set to false (which indicates that IPv6 is disabled) and ProtectionResource is set to share (which indicates that a shared cluster is used). Valid values:
fields.help_zh:
是否开启独享IP。仅IPv6Enabled取值为false（表示不开启IPv6），且ProtectionResource取值为share时（表示使用共享集群）时，使用该参数。取值：

true：表示开启独享IP。

false（默认）：表示不开启独享IP
fields.name: exclusive_ip

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable forced HTTPS redirect. This parameter is used only when HttpsPorts is not empty (which indicates that the domain name uses HTTPS) and HttpPorts is empty (which indicates that the domain name does not use HTTP). Valid values:
fields.help_zh:
是否开启HTTPS的强制跳转。仅HttpsPorts取值不为空（表示域名使用HTTPS协议），且HttpPorts取值为空（表示域名未使用HTTP协议）时，使用该参数。取值：

true：表示开启HTTPS的强制跳转。

false：表示不开启HTTPS的强制跳转
fields.name: focus_https

fields.help_en: Specifies whether HSTS includes subdomains. Valid values:
fields.help_zh:
HSTS是否包含子域名。取值：

true：表示开启。

false：表示不开启
fields.name: hsts_include_sub_domain

fields.help_en: The HSTS expiration time. Unit: seconds
fields.help_zh: HSTS过期时间，单位是秒
fields.name: hsts_max_age

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable HSTS preloading. This feature is disabled by default. Valid values:
fields.help_zh:
是否开启HSTS预加载，默认关闭。取值范围：
true：开启。
false：关闭
fields.name: hsts_preload

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable HTTP/2. This parameter is used only when HttpsPorts is not empty, which indicates that the domain name uses HTTPS. Valid values:
fields.help_zh:
是否开启HTTP2。仅HttpsPorts取值不为空（表示域名使用HTTPS协议）时，使用该参数。取值：

true：表示开启HTTP2。

false（默认）：表示不开启HTTP2
fields.name: http2_enabled

fields.help_en: The listening ports for HTTP
fields.help_zh: HTTP协议的监听端口
fields.name: http_ports

fields.help_en: The listening ports for HTTPS
fields.help_zh: HTTPS协议的监听端口
fields.name: https_ports

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable IPv6. Valid values:
fields.help_zh:
是否开启IPv6。取值：

true：表示开启IPv6。

false（默认）：表示不开启IPv6
fields.name: ipv6_enabled

fields.help_en: The type of protection resource to use. Valid values:
fields.help_zh:
要使用的防护资源类型。取值：

share（默认）：表示使用共享集群。

gslb：表示使用共享集群智能负载均衡
fields.name: protection_resource

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to allow only SM2 client access. This parameter is used only when SM2Enabled is set to true
fields.help_zh:
是否仅客端访问。仅SM2Enabled取值为true时，使用该参数。

true：仅国密客户端才可以访问。

false：国密和非国密均可以访问
fields.name: sm2_access_only

fields.help_en: The ID of the SM2 certificate to add. This parameter is used only when SM2Enabled is set to true
fields.help_zh: 要添加的国密证书的ID。仅SM2Enabled取值为true时，使用该参数
fields.name: sm2_cert_id

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable SM2 certificates
fields.help_zh: 是否开启国密证书
fields.name: sm2_enabled

fields.help_en:
The TLS version to add. This parameter is used only when HttpsPorts is not empty, which indicates that the domain name uses the HTTPS protocol. Valid values:
tlsv1: Supports TLS 1.0 and later. Highest compatibility and lowest security.
tlsv1.1: Supports TLS 1.1 and later. Good compatibility and good security.
tlsv1.2: Supports TLS 1.2 and later. Good compatibility and highest security.
tlsv1.3: Supports only TLS 1.3. Highest security and lowest compatibility
fields.help_zh:
要添加的TLS版本。仅HttpsPorts取值不为空（表示域名使用HTTPS协议）时，使用该参数。取值：
tlsv1(支持TLS1.0及以上版本，兼容性最高，安全性较低。)
tlsv1.1(支持TLS1.1及以上版本，兼容性较好，安全性较好。)
tlsv1.2(支持TLS1.2及以上版本，兼容性较好，安全性最高。)
tlsv1.3(仅支持 TLS 1.3版本，安全性最高，兼容性较低。)
fields.name: tls_version

fields.help_en: The method that WAF uses to obtain the originating IP address of the client. Valid values:
fields.help_zh:
WAF获取客户端真实IP的方式。取值：

0（默认）：表示客户端访问流量到WAF前没有经过其他七层代理转发。

1：表示WAF读取请求头中X-Forwarded-For（XFF）字段的第一个值作为客户端IP。

2：表示WAF读取请求头中由您设置的自定义字段值作为客户端IP。

3：表示WAF读取Proxy Protocol头中的Client IP作为客户端IP
fields.name: xff_header_mode

fields.help_en: The custom header fields used to obtain the client IP address
fields.help_zh: 设置用于获取客户端IP的自定义字段列表
fields.name: xff_headers

fields.help_en: The back-to-origin port
fields.help_zh: 回源端口
fields.name: backend_port

fields.help_en: The listening port
fields.help_zh: 监听端口
fields.name: listen_port

fields.help_en: The protocol of the listening port. Valid values:
fields.help_zh:
监听端口的协议。取值：

http：表示监听端口的协议为HTTP。

https：表示监听端口的协议HTTPS
fields.name: protocol

fields.help_en: The custom port configuration
fields.help_zh: 自定义端口配置
fields.name: backend_ports

fields.help_en: The IP addresses or domain names of the origin servers that correspond to the domain name
fields.help_zh: 域名对应的源站服务器IP或服务器回源域名
fields.name: backends

fields.help_en: The IP addresses or domain names of the secondary origin servers that correspond to the domain name
fields.help_zh: 域名对应的备用源站服务器IP或服务器回源域名
fields.name: backup_backends

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable public cloud disaster recovery. Valid values:

true: Public cloud disaster recovery is enabled.

false (default): Public cloud disaster recovery is not enabled
fields.help_zh:
是否开启公共云容灾。取值：

true：表示开启公共云容灾。

false（默认）：表示不开启公共云容灾
fields.name: cname_enabled

fields.help_en: The connection timeout period. Unit: seconds
fields.help_zh:
连接超时时长。单位：秒。
取值范围：1~3600。
默认值：5
fields.name: connect_timeout

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable forced HTTP back-to-origin. This parameter is used only when HttpsPorts is not empty, which indicates that the domain name uses HTTPS. Valid values:
fields.help_zh:
是否开启强制HTTP回源。仅HttpsPorts取值不为空（表示域名使用HTTPS协议）时，使用该参数。取值：

true：表示开启强制HTTP回源。

false：表示不开启强制HTTP回源
fields.name: focus_http_backend

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable HTTP/2 back-to-origin. Valid values:
fields.help_zh:
HTTP2回源。取值：

true：表示开启HTTP2回源。

false：表示不开启HTTP2回源
fields.name: http2_origin

fields.help_en: The maximum number of concurrent HTTP/2 back-to-origin connections. Valid values: 1 to 512. Default value: 128
fields.help_zh: HTTP2回源最大并发数。取值范围：1-512，默认值：128，单位：个
fields.name: http2_origin_max_concurrency

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable persistent connections. Valid values:
fields.help_zh:
是否保持长连接。取值：

true（默认）：表示保持长连接。

false：表示不保持长连接
fields.name: keepalive

fields.help_en: The number of requests that reuse a persistent connection. Valid values: 60 to 1000. Default value: 1000
fields.help_zh:
复用长连接的请求个数。取值范围：60~1000，默认值：1000，单位：个。

开启长连接后，复用多少个长连接
fields.name: keepalive_requests

fields.help_en: The idle timeout period for persistent connections. Valid values: 1 to 60. Default value: 15. Unit: seconds
fields.help_zh:
空闲长连接超时时间，取值范围：1~60，默认15，单位：秒。

复用的长连接空闲多久后释放
fields.name: keepalive_timeout

fields.help_en:
The load balancing algorithm used for back-to-origin requests. Valid values:

iphash: IP hash algorithm.

roundRobin: round-robin algorithm.

leastTime: Least Time algorithm. This value is available only when ProtectionResource is set to gslb (indicating that the protection resource type uses intelligent load balancing of the shared cluster)
fields.help_zh:
回源时采用的负载均衡算法。取值：

iphash：表示IPHash算法。

roundRobin：表示轮询算法。

leastTime：表示Least Time算法。仅ProtectionResource取值为gslb（表示防护资源类型使用共享集群智能负载均衡）时，可选择该取值
fields.name: loadbalance

fields.help_en: The maximum request body size. Valid values: 2 to 10. Default value: 2. Unit: GB
fields.help_zh:
最大请求体大小。取值范围：2~10，默认值：2，单位：G。
仅旗舰版支持
fields.name: max_body_size

fields.help_en:
Indicates whether the client source IP preservation feature is enabled.
true: The client source IP preservation feature is enabled. After this feature is enabled, backend services can view the originating IP address of the client.
false: The client source IP preservation feature is not enabled
fields.help_zh:
是否开启了保持客户端源IP功能。
true：开启了保持客户端源IP功能。开启后，支持后端服务查看客户端的原始IP地址。
false：未开启保持客户端源IP功能
fields.name: proxy_protocol

fields.help_en: The read timeout period. Unit: seconds
fields.help_zh:
读超时时长，单位：秒。
取值范围：1~3600。
默认值：120
fields.name: read_timeout

fields.help_en: The custom request header field
fields.help_zh: 指定的自定义请求头部字段
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value set for the custom request header field
fields.help_zh: 自定义请求头部字段设定的值
fields.name: value

fields.help_en: The traffic mark header fields and values for the domain name, used to mark traffic processed by WAF
fields.help_zh:
域名的流量标记字段和值，用于标记经过WAF处理的流量。

通过指定自定义请求头部字段和对应的值，当域名的访问流量经过WAF时，WAF自动在请求头部中添加所设定的自定义字段值作为流量标记，便于后端服务统计相关信息
fields.name: request_headers

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to retry when WAF fails to forward requests to the origin server. Valid values:
fields.help_zh:
WAF回源失败时，是否重试。取值：

true（默认）：表示重试。

false：表示不重试
fields.name: retry

fields.help_en: The hybrid cloud forwarding rules. The value is a string converted from a JSON array. Each element in the JSON array is a struct that contains the following fields:
fields.help_zh:
混合云转发规则。使用JSON数组转化的字符串格式表示。JSON数组中的每个元素是一个结构体，包含以下字段：
rs：Array类型 | 表示回源IP地址或者回源CNAME列表

backupRs：Array类型 | 表示回源备用IP地址或者回源CNAME列表，必填，[]表示不设置

location：String类型 | 表示防护节点名称

locationId：Long类型 | 表示防护节点ID
fields.name: routing_rules

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable back-to-origin Server Name Indication (SNI). This parameter is used only when HttpsPorts is not empty, which indicates that the domain name uses HTTPS. Valid values:
fields.help_zh:
是否开启回源SNI。仅HttpsPorts取值不为空（表示域名使用HTTPS协议）时，使用该参数。取值：

true：表示开启回源SNI。

false（默认）：表示不开启回源SNI
fields.name: sni_enabled

fields.help_en:
The value of the custom SNI extension field. If you do not set this parameter, the value of the Host field in the request header is used as the value of the SNI extension field by default.
In most cases, you do not need to customize SNI unless your business has special configuration requirements and you want WAF to use an SNI that is different from the actual request Host in back-to-origin requests (that is, the custom SNI set here).

This parameter is required only when SniEnabled is set to true (indicating that back-to-origin SNI is enabled)
fields.help_zh:
设置自定义SNI扩展字段的值。如果不设置该参数，则默认使用请求头中Host字段的值作为SNI扩展字段的值。
一般情况无需自定义SNI，除非您的业务有特殊配置要求，希望WAF在回源请求中使用与实际请求Host不一致的SNI（即此处设置的自定义SNI）。

仅在SniEnabled取值为true（表示开启回源SNI），需要设置该参数
fields.name: sni_host

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to allow WAF to overwrite WL-Proxy-Client-IP. Valid values:
fields.help_zh:
是否允许WAF覆盖WL-Proxy-Client-IP。取值：

true（默认）：表示允许WAF覆盖。

false：表示不允许WAF覆盖
fields.name: wl_proxy_client_ip

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to allow WAF to overwrite Web-Server-Type. Valid values:
fields.help_zh:
是否允许WAF覆盖Web-Server-Type。取值：

true（默认）：表示允许WAF覆盖。

false：表示不允许WAF覆盖
fields.name: web_server_type

fields.help_en: The write timeout period. Unit: seconds
fields.help_zh:
写超时时长，单位：秒。
取值范围：1~3600。
默认值：120
fields.name: write_timeout

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to allow WAF to overwrite X-Client-IP. Valid values:
fields.help_zh:
是否允许WAF覆盖X-Client-IP。取值：

true（默认）：表示允许WAF覆盖。

false：表示不允许WAF覆盖
fields.name: x_client_ip

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to allow WAF to overwrite X-True-IP. Valid values:
fields.help_zh:
是否允许WAF覆盖X-True-IP。取值：

true（默认）：表示允许WAF覆盖。

false：表示不允许WAF覆盖
fields.name: x_true_ip

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to use X-Forward-For-Proto to pass the protocol used by WAF. Valid values:
fields.help_zh:
X-Forward-For-Proto 传递WAF的协议。取值：

true（默认）：表示传递WAF的协议。

false：表示不传递WAF的协议
fields.name: xff_proto

parameters.help_en: The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The access type of the WAF instance. Valid values:

share (default): CNAME access.

hybrid_cloud_cname: hybrid cloud CNAME access.

If the value is share, or if the value is hybrid_cloud_cname and public cloud disaster recovery is enabled, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2985193.html and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2985192.html operations to verify domain name ownership first. If the domain name is connected to a region in the Chinese mainland, ICP filing must also be completed
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的接入类型。取值：

share（默认）：表示CNAME接入。

hybrid_cloud_cname：表示混合云CNAME接入。

取值为 share，或取值为 hybrid_cloud_cname 且已开启公有云容灾时，需先调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2985193.html和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2985192.html接口完成域名归属权验证；此时若域名接入中国内地地域，还必须已完成ICP备案
parameters.name: access_type

fields.help_en: The tag key
fields.help_zh: 标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value
fields.help_zh: 标签值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The list of tags. You can specify up to 20 tags
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表，最多包含20个子项
parameters.name: tag

schema.description_en: The response returned after a domain name is added
schema.description_zh: 添加域名后的返回结果

DomainInfo.description_en: The information about the added domain name

Cname.description_en: The CNAME assigned by WAF to the domain name

Domain.description_en: The name of the added domain name
